sections.changelog:
Changed

  • The dropdown now fetches each content type separately, so products always get their own group instead of being crowded out of a single flat top-N — result order is categories, then products, then posts.
  • Redrew the submit-button magnifier as a crisp inline SVG and made the collapsed icon button square, fixing the cramped look in icon display mode.

Added

  • Click-through tracking: result clicks in the live dropdown are recorded per query via a lightweight beacon, and the Analytics tab now shows Clicks and CTR columns (also in the CSV export). Live-dropdown searches now count as impressions so the rate is meaningful.
  • Pre-search category selector: an optional hierarchical taxonomy dropdown next to the field (product categories by default) that narrows the live search and the results page to the chosen term and its sub-terms. Toggle and taxonomy choice in Appearance.
  • Popular searches: the dropdown now suggests the most-searched phrases that returned results when the empty field is focused, shown alongside the visitor's recent searches. Toggle and count in Appearance; the list is cached hourly.
  • Search-bar appearance controls: size (S/M/L), corner shape (square/rounded/pill), border/background/text colors, bar width, submit button style (icon/text/hidden) with custom text, and an optional magnifier inside the field — applied through CSS custom properties.
  • Display modes: show the search bar or a magnifier icon that expands on click, chosen separately for desktop and mobile.
  • Navigation-menu placement: add the search bar to a classic menu location via `wp_nav_menu_items`; block themes place the search block inside the navigation block.
  • Classic sidebar widget (`MVweb_SS_Widget`) with title, placeholder, accent color and post-type scope, covering classic widget areas and the block-based widgets screen.
  • Ready-made synonym dictionaries (`MVweb_SS_Dictionaries`): curated packs (brands, electronics parts, adhesives) installed and updated from a pinned public repository via one admin button, stored in a non-autoloaded option and merged into the synonym engine alongside the local list.
  • Phrase-aware synonyms: multi-word entries (e.g. "жидкие гвозди", "материнская плата") are tokenized with the index stemmer and matched when the query contains all of their stems.
  • Initial scaffold.
  • Index table `{prefix}mvweb_ss_index` (utf8mb4) with schema versioning via `MVweb_SS_Schema`; created on activation, upgraded on `admin_init`.
  • Search tokenizer and stemmer (`MVweb_SS_Tokenizer`, `MVweb_SS_Stemmer`) with Russian and English morphology, hyphenated-SKU handling and stop words.
  • Object indexer (`MVweb_SS_Indexer`) covering title, content, excerpt, taxonomies, whitelisted custom fields and WooCommerce SKU/attributes/variation SKUs, with published-only privacy filtering and idempotent writes.
  • Incremental index sync (`MVweb_SS_Sync`) on post/product edits, status transitions, trashing and deletion, with re-entrancy and autosave/revision guards.
  • Background full reindex (`MVweb_SS_Reindex`) with cursor-based batching, a lock to prevent concurrent runs, WP-CLI command `wp mvweb-ss reindex` and admin AJAX endpoints.
  • Ranked search engine (`MVweb_SS_Query`) with per-source weighting, AND/OR modes, published-only filtering and a hard result limit.
  • Fuzzy typo tolerance (`MVweb_SS_Fuzzy`) with multibyte Levenshtein, a prefiltered candidate lookup and cached results, applied only when direct matches are scarce.
  • Live search REST endpoint (`MVweb_SS_Rest`, `GET mvweb-ss/v1/search`) with input-length limits, per-IP rate limiting, a versioned result cache and WooCommerce-aware result formatting (price, stock, thumbnail).
  • Front-end main-search interception (`MVweb_SS_Search`) replacing the default WordPress search with index-ranked results while leaving the admin search intact.
  • Search bar presentation (`MVweb_SS_Frontend`): shortcode `[mvweb_ss]`, a dynamic block, classic/block theme form replacement and a live dropdown (grouped results with thumbnail, price and stock).
  • Aggregated search query log (`MVweb_SS_Log`) tracking query frequency and result counts, including no-result phrases.
  • Settings page (`MVweb_SS_Admin`, `MVweb_SS_Settings`) under the MVweb hub: search logic, fuzzy toggle, form auto-replace, indexed post types, custom-field whitelist and a one-click reindex.
  • Dropdown details panel (image, price, stock, excerpt), keyboard navigation, a "show all results" link and a full-screen mobile overlay.
  • Out-of-stock handling setting (show / demote / hide) applied in the ranking query for WooCommerce products.
  • Add-to-cart button in the dropdown details panel using WooCommerce's native AJAX add-to-cart (simple products) or a link to the product page (variable/grouped/external).
  • WooCommerce settings block on the General tab (out-of-stock behaviour, add-to-cart toggle), shown only when WooCommerce is active.
  • Result cache is now invalidated when settings are saved.
  • Relevance settings tab: per-source weight overrides, synonym groups, custom stop words, an exclude-from-search list and query-pinned results.
  • Synonym expansion (query-side broadening), custom stop words merged into the tokenizer, exclusion of chosen object IDs from the ranking query, and admin-pinned results promoted to the top of a matching query.
  • Search analytics: a "no results" dashboard widget, an Analytics tab listing no-result and top queries, and a nonce-guarded CSV export and log-clear action (`MVweb_SS_Analytics`).
  • Theme template tags `mvweb_ss_search_bar()` / `mvweb_ss_get_search_bar()` and a `mvweb_ss_results` filter for integrations.
  • Multilingual result filtering for Polylang and WPML (restricts results to the current language; a no-op on monolingual sites).
  • Additional WP-CLI commands: `wp mvweb-ss stats`, `wp mvweb-ss search ` and `wp mvweb-ss clear-log`.
  • Settings export (JSON download) and import (validated through the settings sanitizer) on the Index tab.
  • English-first source strings with a full Russian translation (`languages/*.pot`, `*-ru_RU.po`, `*-ru_RU.mo`), including the MVweb hub strings.
  • Getting started tab: search status (index size, form replacement, mode, typo correction) and copy-to-clipboard snippets for every insertion method (shortcode, block, PHP, theme form).
  • Appearance tab: accent color, search-field placeholder, result-field visibility toggles (thumbnail, price, stock, short description), details-panel and mobile-overlay switches, dropdown width and custom "no results" / "show all" labels.
  • Behavior tab: minimum characters, typing delay, total and per-group suggestion limits, match highlighting, typo-correction hint mode (silent / "Showing results for…" / "Did you mean…?"), result-group order and search-results-page count.
  • Match highlighting in the dropdown (matched parts of result titles wrapped in ``, styled with the accent color).
  • "Did you mean" / "Showing results for" hint built from the closest real word in the top result's title when a typo triggers the fuzzy fallback, surfaced through the REST `corrected` field.
  • Coverage-first ranking: results matching more of the query words now rank above results matching fewer, before the field-weighted score is applied (keeps the most relevant matches on top when the search broadens).
  • Matching categories: product (or post) categories whose name matches the query now appear as a separate "Categories" group at the top of the dropdown, linking to the category archive, with an item count and parent context. Toggle in Appearance; the searched taxonomies are filterable.
  • Filter tabs in the dropdown (All / Categories / Products / …) that narrow the visible group without a new request. Toggle in Appearance.
  • Keyword search redirects: an exact query can be sent straight to a URL (Relevance tab).
  • Per-instance form config through shortcode/block attributes: `placeholder`, `accent` and `types` (search scope) — different forms on one page can look and search differently.
  • Grid results layout option for the dropdown (list or card grid).
  • Recent searches: the dropdown shows the visitor's recent queries (stored locally) when the empty field is focused, with a clear action. Toggle in Appearance.
  • GTIN/UPC/EAN and brand are now indexed and searchable for WooCommerce products, with their own relevance weights.

Fixed

  • Numeric-only queries (e.g. an SKU) no longer trigger a type error in the fuzzy fallback.
  • Admin settings tabs now use the correct MVweb UI Kit markup — real toggle sliders, `form-row` label/field columns, block subtitles as siblings and a visible Save button — fixing the broken settings-page layout.
  • Admin notices from other plugins no longer appear inside the settings card; the `.wp-header-end` anchor now sits at the top of the page so notices dock above the layout, full width.
  • Completed the Russian translation for previously untranslated controls (Save Changes, Full reindex, Export, meta field keys, synonym groups, excluded IDs).
  • Clearer setting labels and inline help text across the settings tabs (search logic, typo correction, form replacement, weights, pinning, analytics and index screens).
